	Our client, a leading manufacturer of LDPE, LLDPE, and HDPE bags and rolls including Pure Water Rolls, Yogurt Rolls, Shrink Wrapping Rolls and Bags, Mattress Liners, Jumbo Liners, Pallet Liners, Shopping Bags, and other industrial nylon products, is currently seeking a smart, organized, and experienced HR Manager for immediate employment.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing administrative operations, supervising staff activities, supporting HR functions, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations within the organization.
	The candidate must possess strong leadership, people-management, and organizational skills, especially within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

	Supervise daily administrative and operational activities
	Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee documentation
	Monitor staff attendance, discipline, and workplace coordination
	Maintain employee records and HR documentation
	Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
	Coordinate office administration and facility management
	Prepare reports, schedules, and operational updates
	Assist management in staff welfare, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution
	Ensure effective communication between management and staff


Requirements


	Minimum of OND / HND / B.Sc. in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or related field
	Proven experience in HR and Administration
	Good knowledge of HR processes and administrative operations
	Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
	Ability to multitask and work under pressure
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
	Manufacturing industry experience is an added advantage.


Method of Application

Human Resources Manager Job at Addoz Integrated Resources




        
    

        
        Addoz Integrated Resources - Our client, a leading manufacturer of LDPE, LLDPE, and HDPE bags and rolls including Pure Water Rolls, Yogurt Rolls, Shrink Wrapping Rolls and Bags, Mattress Liners, Jumbo Liners, Pallet Liners, Shopping Bags, and other industrial nylon products is recruiting to fill the position below: 

Job Position:  Human Resources Manager

Job Location: Sango-Otta, Ogun
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: Manufacturing
Industry: Flexible Packaging (Polythene Nylon)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	Our client, a leading manufacturer of LDPE, LLDPE, and HDPE bags and rolls including Pure Water Rolls, Yogurt Rolls, Shrink Wrapping Rolls and Bags, Mattress Liners, Jumbo Liners, Pallet Liners, Shopping Bags, and other industrial nylon products, is currently seeking a smart, organized, and experienced HR Manager for immediate employment.
	The ideal candidate will be responsible for overseeing administrative operations, supervising staff activities, supporting HR functions, and ensuring smooth day-to-day operations within the organization.
	The candidate must possess strong leadership, people-management, and organizational skills, especially within a fast-paced manufacturing environment.


Key Responsibilities


	Supervise daily administrative and operational activities
	Support recruitment, onboarding, and employee documentation
	Monitor staff attendance, discipline, and workplace coordination
	Maintain employee records and HR documentation
	Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures
	Coordinate office administration and facility management
	Prepare reports, schedules, and operational updates
	Assist management in staff welfare, performance monitoring, and conflict resolution
	Ensure effective communication between management and staff


Requirements


	Minimum of OND / HND / B.Sc. in Human Resources, Business Administration, Industrial Relations, or related field
	Proven experience in HR and Administration
	Good knowledge of HR processes and administrative operations
	Strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills
	Ability to multitask and work under pressure
	Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications
	Manufacturing industry experience is an added advantage.


Method of Application
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using " HR Manager " as the subject of the email.

Customer Service Representative Job at Avetium Consult




        
    

        
        Avetium Consult is a Business Process Outsourcing and Technology solution company incorporated in Nigeria. Avetium Consult is what happens when top experts of top multinationals from diverse fields and similar values come together to deliver transformational solutions.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Representative

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
     

            
    




	Handle inbound and outbound customer calls professionally and efficiently.
	Communicate fluently with customers in French and English.
	Respond to customer enquiries, complaints, and requests promptly.
	Provide accurate information on products, services, and processes.
	Resolve customer issues or escalate complex matters appropriately.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and transactions.
	Follow approved call scripts, procedures, and quality standards.
	Achieve assigned call centre KPIs, including service quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.
	Maintain confidentiality of customer and company information.
	Participate in required training and coaching sessions.
	Perform other duties as assigned by the Team Lead.


Job Requirements


	Minimum of an OND/NCE or equivalent qualification.
	Fluency in Yoruba, Igbo or Hausa is a key requirement
	Previous experience in a call centre, customer service, or BPO environment is an advantage.
	Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
	Good listening, problem-solving, and customer-handling skills.
	Proficiency in using computers and basic customer service applications.
	Ability to work under pressure and meet performance targets.
	Ability to work effectively in a team and adapt to shift schedules.
	Language Proficiency: Yoruba, Igbo, Hausa.


Salary
N120,000 monthly.
